name: indxr-video
description: Standalone Remotion workspace for INDXR marketing clips — deliberately OUTSIDE the Turborepo build graph (ADR-089). Own node_modules, own install, never deploys.

scripts.copy-source: mkdir -p public && cp ../../tests/playwright/capture/recordings/core-flow.webm public/core-flow.webm && cp ../../tests/playwright/capture/recordings/core-flow-dark.webm public/core-flow-dark.webm && for n in dw-empty dw-loading dw-error dw-cost dw-success dw-library dw-viewer dw-speakers dw-timestamps dw-summary dw-export; do cp ../../apps/marketing/public/docs/screenshots/$n-light.png ../../apps/marketing/public/docs/screenshots/$n-dark.png public/; done
